## Rules

`CONTACT != ENDORSEMENT`

`INTEREST != COMMITMENT`

`NDA != FINANCING`

`TERM SHEET != CLOSED FINANCING`

`MONEY OFFERED != MONEY ACCEPTED`

Every proposed transaction should be evaluated for both economics and freedom:

```text
CAPITAL
+ PROBABILITY OF CLOSE
+ STRATEGIC VALUE
+ DILUTION / REPAYMENT COST
+ IP COST
+ EXCLUSIVITY COST
+ FOUNDER AUTONOMY COST
+ GOVERNANCE COST
= REAL DEAL QUALITY
```
